sources.title: IEC 61131-3 Programmable controllers - Part 3: Programming languages
sources.documentNumber: IEC 61131-3 (edition 3.0, 2013 is the widely referenced edition)
sources.notes: Defines ST, LD, FBD, IL (deprecated) and SFC, the elementary data types and the standard function blocks TON, TOF, TP, R_TRIG, F_TRIG, CTU, CTD, CTUD. PLC Lab summarizes behavior in original words; the standard text is not reproduced.

sources.title: IEC 61131-2 Programmable controllers - Part 2: Equipment requirements and tests
sources.notes: Defines digital input types 1, 2 and 3 and their voltage/current thresholds. PLC Lab uses simplified thresholds and marks them as a simulation approximation.

sources.title: IEC 61131-9 Single-drop digital communication interface for small sensors and actuators (SDCI, IO-Link)
NAMUR basic information (Beckhoff Information System, EL3182 documentation)
sources.notes: Vendor summary of NAMUR NE 43 signal levels: measurement information between 3.8 mA and 20.5 mA, failure information at or below 3.6 mA and at or above 21.0 mA. The NAMUR recommendation itself is published by NAMUR (namur.net).

sources.title: MODBUS Application Protocol Specification V1.1b3
sources.notes: Function codes 03 (read holding registers) and 04 (read input registers), the PDU structure and exception codes 01 to 0B. The specification download page refused automated access during authoring, so the document identity was not re-checked.
